test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A drainage tile is a cylindrical shell 42 cm long. The inside and outside diameters are 8 cm and 14 cm, respectively. What is the volume (in cm³) of clay required for the tile? (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the cylindrical shell (h) = 42 cm

Inside diameter = 8 cm, so inside radius (r₁) = 8/2 = 4 cm

Outside diameter = 14 cm, so outside radius (r₂) = 14/2 = 7 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Volume of clay required = Volume of outer cylinder - Volume of inner cylinder

Volume of cylinder = πr²h
